verdict.rationale: There is no documented bulk or batch feature. Bulk work can only be pieced together from adjacent capabilities: a REST API to programmatically manage contacts and schedule calls (scriptable at scale), conversation filtering, recurring scheduled workflows, and automatic age-based deletion of contacts and call data. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch endpoints or UI actions (e.g. bulk contact import, bulk call scheduling, multi-select edits/deletes), documentation of batch limits, and hands-on corroboration.
